name: Cheque Presentment Notification V 02
definition: The ChequePresentmentNotification message is sent by a drawer bank, or a bank acting on behalf of the drawer bank to the bank on which a/several cheque(s) has been drawn (the drawee bank).|It is used to advise the drawee bank, or confirm to an enquiring bank, the details concerning the cheque(s) referred to in the message.

GroupHeader.name: Group Header
GroupHeader.definition: Set of characteristics shared by all individual cheques included in the message.

Cheque.name: Cheque
Cheque.definition: Specifies the details of the cheque.

SupplementaryData.name: Supplementary Data
SupplementaryData.definition: Additional information that cannot be captured in the structured elements and/or any other specific block.
